A little piece of the Wizarding World in Hanoi 🪄✨
Oct 2026 • Friends
Always Cafe was one of the most magical and unexpectedly memorable experiences of my Vietnam trip. As a Harry Potter fan, walking in felt like stepping into a little corner of the Wizarding World. The floating candles, Hogwarts banners, potion bottles, magical props, cozy corners and all the tiny details throughout the cafe are clearly created with so much love. You can even dress up with robes, hats and wands, which makes the whole experience even more fun.

And then there’s the merchandise. There are so many lovely things to look at and take home! I absolutely loved browsing through it. The menu was equally delightful, with so many creative Harry Potter-inspired options. I tried the Amortenia, Polyjuice Potion and Felix Felicis, along with their pizza, and honestly, the food and drinks were far beyond what I expected from a themed cafe. Everything was delicious, beautifully presented and genuinely enjoyable, not just something that looks good for the theme.

The atmosphere was probably my favourite part. I visited in the morning and the cafe had such a cheerful, warm energy, with Potterheads chatting, taking pictures, playing games and simply having fun. It felt less like visiting a cafe and more like sharing a little magical experience with fellow fans.

The staff were also very sweet, polite and welcoming. They seemed quite busy managing the lively crowd at times, but I really appreciated how hard-working, attentive and considerate they remained throughout. They continued to make everyone feel welcome and comfortable, even during the busier moments.

And somehow, I loved it enough to visit twice in the same morning! I had different friends with me on each visit, and since I had to leave for the airport shortly afterwards, I knew I couldn’t leave Hanoi without going back one more time. Those two visits ended up becoming such a lovely memory from my trip.

Always Cafe has genuinely made Hanoi a little more special for me. I still get little flashbacks of that cheerful morning, the magical decor, the food, the drinks and everyone having such a good time. ❤️

I would absolutely love to return to Hanoi someday, and when I do, Always Cafe will definitely be one of my first stops. A must-visit for every Potterhead, and honestly, for anyone who wants to experience a little bit of magic in Hanoi. 🪄⚡️
